name: io.skaphos/sting
description: Read-only commit and repository-activity queries over a time window, for GitHub and GitLab.

environmentVariables.name: STING_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub personal access token with read-only repository scope. sting uses its own token rather than reading GITHUB_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: STING_GITLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab personal access token with read-only scope. sting uses its own token rather than reading GITLAB_TOKEN.
